prompt: A tidy printed classroom duty-roster poster, headed 'Classroom Duty Roster - Week 7', with a two-column table (PUPIL, CHORE), one row per pupil. Five pupils -- ANA, BEN, CATO, DEV, ELLA -- rotate through five chores -- BOARD, PLANTS, RECYCLING, LIBRARY, PETS. In WEEK 1 the pairing is Ana=BOARD, Ben=PLANTS, Cato=RECYCLING, Dev=LIBRARY, Ella=PETS. Every following week the whole class rotates: each pupil moves ONE chore further down that chore list, wrapping from the last chore back to the first. Work the rotation forward to WEEK 7 and fill the table with each pupil's correct Week-7 chore. Print each pupil's name with the exact chore they are on in Week 7. Neat table, bold header, no other text.
